about:
# ChatEmoji

Turns emoticons, `:shortcodes:` and real emoji characters in chat into pictures.
For WoW: Forever, Classic Era, TBC Anniversary, Wrath (Titan), Cataclysm, Mists and Retail.

- `:)` becomes 🙂, `<3` a heart, `xD`, `QQ`, `o/`, `o7` and about 140 text emoticons in all
- `:joy:`, `:fire:`, `:+1:` ... 446 pictures from Twemoji
- emoji characters (🙂 ❤️ 👍🏽) that arrive in chat are shown as pictures too
- links, colours and normal text are left alone (`http://x.com:)`, `(8)`, `A)` stay as typed)
- chat bubbles above characters show the pictures as well
- `/emoji` opens a picker: click a picture to put its code in the chat box; switches and picture size

Players without the addon see the plain text you typed.

Install: extract the ZIP into `Interface/AddOns` (the folder must be called `ChatEmoji`).

Pictures: [Twemoji](https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji), CC-BY 4.0 (see CREDITS.txt). Code: GPL-3.0.

## Development

- `python tools/build_assets.py` downloads the artwork and writes `Media/*.tga` and `Data.lua`
- `python tools/test_addon.py` runs the addon on a mock client (needs `pip install lupa`)
- `python tools/render_mock.py` draws an HTML preview of chat and picker from the real code
- `python tools/package.py --check | --zip dist | --install <AddOns\ChatEmoji>`
- CurseForge builds from this repository through a push webhook; `.pkgmeta` says what is left out

releases.name: ChatEmoji 0.2.0
releases.notes:
## ChatEmoji 0.2.0

Chat bubbles above characters show the pictures too.

### What's new
- Chat bubbles show the pictures. A short time after a say, yell, emote, party or NPC chat event the visible bubbles are read and their text goes through the same converter as the chat lines. Switch: "Chat bubbles" in `/emoji`, or `/emoji bubbles on|off`.

### State
Checked on the mock client only (179 checks, Lua 5.1). It has not been tried in the game: whether the bubble resizes around the picture, and whether the bubbles of WoW: Forever can be reached through `C_ChatBubbles.GetAllChatBubbles` at all, is still to be seen. See CHANGELOG.md for 0.1.1 and 0.1.0.

### Install
Extract the ZIP into `Interface/AddOns` (the folder is `ChatEmoji`). SHA-256 checksum is attached.

releases.name: ChatEmoji 0.1.1
releases.notes:
## ChatEmoji 0.1.1

Fixes an error report seen with the gamepad interface.

### What's new
- The `/emoji` picker no longer opens the chat box itself. Doing that ran Blizzard's gamepad chat focus code in this addon's execution and could later be reported as `ADDON_ACTION_FORBIDDEN` for `SetPreferredGamepadInteractTarget()` when a panel such as the game menu was closed. A click now only puts the code into a chat box that is already open; otherwise it asks you to open chat first.

### State
The cause was found by reading Blizzard's code and the change is covered by the mock client checks (157, Lua 5.1); it has not been confirmed in the game yet. See CHANGELOG.md for 0.1.0.

### Install
Extract the ZIP into `Interface/AddOns` (the folder is `ChatEmoji`). SHA-256 checksum is attached.

releases.name: ChatEmoji 0.1.0
releases.notes:
## ChatEmoji 0.1.0

First release. Emoticons, `:shortcodes:` and real emoji characters in chat are shown as pictures.

### What's new
- Emoticons such as `:)` `:D` `;)` `:(` `<3` `xD` `QQ` `o/` `o7` (about 140 in all) become pictures. They only count as whole words, so `http://x.com:)`, `(8)` and `A)` stay text.
- `:joy:`, `:fire:`, `:+1:` and the rest of the 446 Twemoji pictures (CC-BY 4.0).
- Emoji characters that arrive in chat are shown as pictures as well.
- Links, colours and normal text are left alone.
- `/emoji` opens a picker (click a picture to put its code in the chat box) with switches and the picture size.
- The TOC lists Interface numbers for Classic Era, TBC Anniversary, Wrath (Titan), Cataclysm, Mists, Retail and WoW: Forever.

### State
The chat conversion was seen working in WoW: Forever. The `/emoji` window and the other game versions have not been tried yet. The addon was run against a mock client (154 checks, Lua 5.1), including the fallback for clients that have no `ChatFrameUtil`.

### Install
Extract the ZIP into `Interface/AddOns` (the folder is `ChatEmoji`). SHA-256 checksum is attached.
